title: Sparse Autoencoders for Mechanistic Interpretability in NLP: A Critical Survey of Recoverability, Interpretability, and Utility
abstract: arXiv:2610.20139v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a promising approach to mechanistic interpretability by decomposing language-model activations into sparse, potentially interpretable features. However, differences in design assumptions, evaluation objectives, and experimental settings complicate conclusions about their effectiveness. We present a critical survey of 138 studies on SAEs in natural language processing. Our contributions are fourfold: (1) we propose a task-grounded taxonomy connecting dictionary design, feature operations, and NLP functions; (2) we examine how sparsity allocation, geometry, data coverage, and inference affect feature recoverability; (3) we assess evidence for semantic interpretability, mechanistic faithfulness, and behavioral utility; and (4) we synthesize findings across multilingual processing, retrieval, reasoning, classification, and behavioral regulation, highlighting the roles of objectives, baselines, super

translated_title: 面向自然语言处理机械可解释性的稀疏自编码器：关于可恢复性、可解释性与实用性的批判性综述
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）已成为一种有前景的机械可解释性方法，它通过将语言模型的激活分解为稀疏的、潜在可解释的特征来实现解释。然而，设计假设、评估目标和实验设置方面的差异使得对其有效性的判断变得复杂。我们对138项关于自然语言处理中稀疏自编码器的研究进行了批判性综述。我们的贡献有四个方面：（1）我们提出了一个以任务为基础的分类体系，将字典设计、特征操作与NLP功能联系起来；（2）我们考察了稀疏性分配、几何结构、数据覆盖和推理如何影响特征的可恢复性；（3）我们评估了关于语义可解释性、机制忠实性和行为效用方面的证据；（4）我们综合了多语言处理、检索、推理、分类和行为调控等领域的研究发现，强调了目标函数、基线方法以及叠加（superposition，原文此处截断）等因素的作用。
tldr: 本文对138项NLP领域的稀疏自编码器研究进行了批判性综述，提出了连接字典设计与NLP功能的任务导向分类体系，并系统评估了特征可恢复性、语义可解释性与行为效用方面的证据。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a critical survey of 138 studies on sparse autoencoders in NLP, proposing a task-grounded taxonomy linking dictionary design to NLP functions and systematically evaluating evidence on feature recoverability, semantic interpretability, and behavioral utility.
